independent_variable: Single-pass model diagnosis versus bounded controlled-graph orchestration; provider, transport profile 1.12, Evidence strategy, snapshots, budgets, schemas, Tool Gateway, Evidence persistence and deterministic Gate are held constant.
rules_collection_disclosure: The unchanged rules reference uses a fixed twelve-read collection schedule, while model arms plan bounded reads. Rules comparisons are secondary and do not isolate orchestration alone.
held_constant: All arms use the exact same 160 immutable snapshot hashes and observation windows.
Both model arms use transport profile 1.12, DeepSeek Flash, temperature zero, disabled thinking and 2048 maximum output tokens.
Both model arms use the promoted GC-aware causal-scope Evidence strategy without historical memory.
Both model arms use the same six-provider, four-logical-model and twelve-read ceilings.
Schemas, public cause taxonomy, typed read-only Tool Gateway, Evidence construction, immutable storage and deterministic Evidence Gate are unchanged.
No arm has Ground Truth, evaluator labels, write tools, approval authority, recovery execution or verifier authority.
execution_order_detail: For dataset row i, rotate [rules-only, single-agent, controlled-graph] left by i modulo three. Execute each case/arm exactly once unless a complete matching outcome already exists.
runtime_label_isolation_detail: The runner has no evaluator-label argument and must validate source, protocol and input hashes without opening labels. The scorer may hash/load labels only after all 480 outcomes and runtime audits validate.

conditional_metrics.gate_precision: Correct Gate-passing Top-1 faults divided by all Gate PASS outcomes; report 0/0 as unavailable.
conditional_metrics.unsupported_conclusion_rate: Wrong ranked causes divided by all ranked causes; report 0/0 as unavailable.
conditional_metrics.fabricated_reference_rate: Unresolved or cross-Incident references divided by all cited references; report 0/0 as unavailable.

completion_rule: Complete the run only after all 480 outcomes are retained and scoreable. Publish a null, negative or unavailable effect without tuning, deletion or selective rerun.
claim_rule: The primary single-agent-to-controlled-graph metric is IMPROVED only under the frozen paired scorer, 95% interval, Holm correction, minimum relevant effect and safety/resource gates. Otherwise retain NO_PROVEN_IMPROVEMENT or REGRESSED.
post_score_stopping_rule: Do not tune on or rerun this holdout after labels are opened. This single complete result ends FC4f4 regardless of direction; a failed gate starts a new disjoint development and confirmation cycle.
limitations: This is a local synthetic/simulated-observation lab confirmation, not a production incident, human-time, active-labor, MTTR, recurrence or real-world reliability measurement.
The deterministic rate-card upper bound is not actual provider billing; FC8 remains externally blocked on invoice/export and allocation data.
The rules arm uses a fixed collection schedule while model arms plan reads, so rules comparisons are secondary references rather than a one-variable orchestration estimate.
Temperature zero does not make provider outputs deterministic; all provider-time variation and failures remain in the once-only paired result.
No confirmed historical incidents are available. This three-arm lab run cannot satisfy the FC4e fourth arm or FC5 confirmed-history effect.
No human approval, write action, recovery execution, health-verification outcome or recurrence window is present.
